# Credits

SafeNameAndChat is written and maintained by [@WPMGPRoSToTeMa](https://github.com/WPMGPRoSToTeMa), who signs the plugin as *WPMG.PRoSToC0der*.

:::note

This is a third-party project, not a ReHLDS organization one. It is documented here because it is commonly deployed alongside ReHLDS and because it covers the same class of exploit as the organization's deprecated [ReLocalizeBugFix](/docs/relocalizebugfix). Support requests belong in its own issue tracker, not in the ReHLDS one.

:::

## How to help

Run it on your server and report any problems through the [issue tracker](https://github.com/WPMGPRoSToTeMa/SafeNameAndChat/issues), including your Metamod version, whether the server runs ReHLDS, your `SafeNameAndChat.cfg`, and the exact name or chat message that reproduces the issue. Pull requests are also welcome.
